heading: Hi, I'm Madison
bio: Founded in 2026 by certified master groomers, Blackberry Luxury Grooming was built on a simple premise: dogs deserve a peaceful, enjoyable grooming experience without harsh cages or hurried treatments.

principles.title: 100% Sensitive Personalized Care
principles.desc: We exclusively use shampoos formulated for sensitive canine skin.

principles.title: Fear-Free Certified Handling
principles.desc: Our staff is trained in positive reinforcement techniques to calm nervous or rescue pets.

principles.title: Private Quiet Suites
principles.desc: Individual relaxing areas instead of loud, stressful cage banks.
